G01.gig_title: Internal WSH Management System Audit for Fuel Depot
G01.short_description: Looking for a WSH auditor to carry out an internal audit of the workplace safety and health management system at our fuel storage and distribution depot. We are an energy logistics company with two tank farms and about 90 staff. The auditor would review our risk assessments, permit-to-work records, contractor controls and emergency drills against bizSAFE Level 3 and MOM requirements, interview supervisors on site, and log each finding with evidence. Deliverable: a completed audit report with a findings register and a corrective action tracker. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
G01.additional_notes: Auditor must be registered with MOM as a WSH auditor.

G02.gig_title: Operating Model Review for Electronics Training Workshop
G02.short_description: A private technical training institute runs an electronics assembly workshop for about 200 students a year and wants it run more leanly. An independent adviser is needed to review how component stock, equipment maintenance and supplier ordering are managed today, and to recommend a simpler operating model with clear owners. Deliverable: a written operations review with a prioritised set of recommendations for the institute's management. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

G03.gig_title: Hardware Distributor Sourcing and Reorder Rule Redesign
G03.short_description: Looking for a procurement and sourcing specialist to restructure how we buy hardware for resale. We distribute networking and server equipment to software and managed-service firms, work with about 40 active suppliers, and write off roughly S$1.2 million of slow stock a year. The specialist would review our supplier base and purchasing terms, rebuild our reorder rules, prepare a sourcing playbook, and brief our directors on the trade-offs. Deliverable: a supplier consolidation plan, a reorder-rule workbook and a sourcing policy document. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G04.gig_title: Mystery Shopping Review of Law Practice Intake Counters
G04.short_description: Looking for someone to run mystery shopping visits across the four walk-in intake counters of our law practice, which advises freight forwarders and warehouse operators on contract and cargo disputes. The shopper would pose as a prospective client with a short scripted query, then score the greeting, clarity of advice, fee explanation and follow-up against our checklist, and note anything that could mislead a client. Deliverable: a scored visit report for each counter with short recommendations for the managing partner. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

G05.gig_title: Demurrage and Detention Claims for Reefer Imports
G05.short_description: I run a frozen seafood import business that brings reefer containers in from Indonesia and Vietnam. Over the last year about 60 containers sat at port beyond their free days, and we think some charges were wrongly billed. I need a shipping claims specialist to rebuild the day counts from the bills of lading and gate records, prepare each claim file, and draft the dispute letters to the shipping lines. Deliverable: a set of completed claim packs with calculations and supporting documents. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G06.gig_title: Process Operations Staff Handbook Section for Chemical Plant
G06.short_description: We make hospital-grade disinfectants and cleaning chemicals for clinics and hospitals from a small plant in Tuas. We need an experienced process person to write the operations section of our staff handbook: shift handover, batch records, line clearance and how deviations are escalated. Turn our existing procedures and rough notes into plain rules for operators, and flag any procedure that looks unsafe or inconsistent. Deliverable: a finished handbook section of about 12 pages in our template. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G08.gig_title: Genetic Counselling Materials for Employer Screening Package
G08.short_description: We are a corporate health consultancy serving mid-sized employers, and we are adding a hereditary cancer screening option to our packages. We need a genetic counsellor to write the pre-test counselling script and consent information sheet, and to advise how results should be disclosed and when to refer people on. Deliverable: a counselling script, a participant information sheet and a one-page disclosure and referral guide. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
G08.additional_notes: Counsellor should hold a recognised genetic counselling qualification.

G09.gig_title: Registered Design Infringement Opinion for Storage Products
G09.short_description: We need an IP lawyer to advise whether a competitor's new range of stackable storage bins infringes our registered designs, and what we can do about it. We are a plastics moulding manufacturer and the bins are one of our best sellers, so the position matters. Deliverable: a written infringement opinion with recommended next steps. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
G09.additional_notes: Counsel must be admitted to practise in Singapore.

G10.gig_title: Technical Production for Shipyard Anniversary Dinner
G10.short_description: A shipyard group is hosting its anniversary dinner for about 600 guests in a convention hall and needs a technical production specialist to build the show. The specialist would design the lighting and audio-visual setup, plan the rigging, write the cue sheet, and run the technical rehearsal the day before. Deliverable: a finished lighting plan, AV rig drawing and show cue sheet. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G07.gig_title: Residents' Shuttle Bus Operating Plan and Licence Application
G07.short_description: A property developer with a large housing estate under construction in the west is setting up a free shuttle for residents moving into its first completed blocks. The first phase will hand over roughly 1,800 homes, so the service has to be sized carefully. It wants a bus operations expert to design the route and timetable, size the fleet and driver roster, build the cost model, and complete the application documents for the Land Transport Authority. Deliverable: a finished bus operating plan with timetable, roster and cost model, and the completed licence application set. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

G11.gig_title: Mystery Shopping Across Garden Centre Outlets
G11.short_description: A garden centre and landscaping retailer with five outlets in Singapore wants mystery shopping visits to check how staff advise customers on plants, planting services and installation quotes. The shopper would visit each outlet twice with a short scripted enquiry, score product advice, quote clarity and follow-up, and compare the outlets against one another. Deliverable: a scored comparison report for all five outlets with recommendations for management. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G12.gig_title: Succession and Leadership Framework for Social Service Agency
G12.short_description: A social service agency with about 300 staff and volunteers needs a talent management specialist to build its succession and leadership development framework. The specialist would define the critical roles, design the competency model, and prepare talent review templates and a development plan for the 20 identified successors. Deliverable: a finished succession framework with competency model, review templates and individual development plans. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

G14.short_description: We are the logistics section of a public agency with six depots, and our shared customer enquiries mailbox has about 900 unanswered emails. We need someone to sort and categorise them, draft replies for our officers to send, and advise which enquiries keep recurring. Deliverable: a cleared mailbox with a categorised log and 10 template replies. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G15.gig_title: Build or Buy Assessment for Client Portal
G15.short_description: I run a Singapore wealth management firm and we are deciding whether to build or buy a client portal. I need an experienced product development adviser to assess our requirements, compare the build and buy options on cost and risk, and recommend an approach. We have 3,000 clients and a small in-house technology team. Deliverable: a build-or-buy assessment report with a recommended product roadmap. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G17.gig_title: Quality Manual Copy-Edit Before Regulatory Inspection
G17.short_description: A contract biopharmaceutical manufacturer has rewritten its 90-page quality manual ahead of an inspection and wants it proofread and copy-edited. The editor should fix grammar and consistency, check that SOP references and terms match throughout, and flag any statements that look unclear or unsupported. Deliverable: a clean edited manual with a tracked-changes copy and a short list of flagged issues. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G18.gig_title: Customer List Clean-up for Harbour Cruise Operator
G18.short_description: I run a harbour cruise and marine attraction business with a customer list of about 6,000 entries spread over three spreadsheets, with duplicates and missing details. I need someone to merge and de-duplicate the records, standardise names and contact fields, fill obvious gaps, and advise how to keep the list clean in future. Deliverable: a single cleaned customer workbook with a short data-quality guide. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G19.short_description: A healthcare training centre that runs continuing education courses for nurses and allied health staff wants its flagship 60-slide course deck redesigned. The specialist would restructure the learning flow, rewrite slides in plain language, redraw the diagrams and add short knowledge checks, and advise the trainers on pacing. Deliverable: a redesigned slide deck with trainer notes and an editable master template. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
G19.additional_notes: Start date should be within the next month.

G20.gig_title: Review of Auxiliary Police Unit Deployment and Orders
G20.short_description: A financial services group that runs its own auxiliary police unit across 12 premises wants an independent expert to review how the unit is deployed and what its standing orders say. The expert would compare them with the legal requirements for auxiliary police forces and recommend changes. Deliverable: a written review of deployment, training and powers with a prioritised recommendation list for management. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G13.short_description: We need our quality assurance capability deck redesigned into clear, consistent slides. We are an engineering services company that installs and commissions equipment for food factories, and clients often ask how we control quality and hygiene during installation. The current 38 slides are crowded, inconsistent and hard to follow. The designer would restructure the story, redraw the process diagrams and apply our brand colours and fonts. Brand guidelines and the original deck will be shared on day one. Deliverable: a finished redesigned deck of about 25 slides with an editable master template. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G16.gig_title: Housekeeping Standards and Staffing Model for Crew Lodge
G16.short_description: We operate a crew lodge with 280 rooms used by offshore and energy sector workers on rotation, and housekeeping complaints are rising. We need a housekeeping specialist to audit current practice, redesign the room standards and cleaning schedules, set staffing levels for the busy changeover days, and advise our facilities manager on contractor management and supply costs. Cleaning is done by a contractor with about 35 staff on two shifts. G21.short_description: We need someone to rebuild the production scheduling and capacity plan for the prototype machining workshop that sits inside our engineering consultancy. The specialist would map the current flow, set up a realistic weekly schedule and load plan, and train the workshop supervisor to run it. Deliverable: a working scheduling workbook, a capacity plan and a one-page procedure for the supervisor. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G22.gig_title: Copy-Edit of Carbon Credit Due Diligence Guide
G22.short_description: We are a carbon credit brokerage serving logistics and shipping companies that want to offset their emissions. We need an experienced editor to proofread and copy-edit our 70-page due diligence guide for clients, check that terms and numbers are consistent, and flag any claims that could be read as misleading. Deliverable: a clean edited guide, a tracked-changes copy and a list of flagged claims. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G23.gig_title: Dementia Day Care Programme Operating Manual
G23.short_description: A public agency that funds 15 community care centres wants a specialist to write the operating manual for a new dementia day care programme. Deliverable: a complete programme operating manual with templates for assessment, care plans and incident reports. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

G34.short_description: We need a marine general manager to review how our small tug and barge fleet is organised and run. Deliverable: a written communications review with a recommended 6-month content plan. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.
